bias.zh: 转为偏空 · 跌破 30 日均线

read.en: Applied Materials fell 6.7% on Oct 13 to $464.24 on volume 1.8 times its 20-day average. It closed below its 30-day average ($475.6) as well as the 5-day ($499.8), 10-day ($515.2) and 100-day ($517.0), holding only above the 200-day ($436.5). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 13 but is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($543), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月13日以 20 日均量 1.8 倍的成交量下跌 6.7%，收于 $464.24。股价收于 30 日均线（$475.6）以及 5 日（$499.8）、10 日（$515.2）和 100 日均线（$517.0）下方，仅守在 200 日均线（$436.5）之上。MACD 于 10月13日下穿信号线，但仍在零轴上方，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$543），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The drop broke both written supports, the Oct 12 low ($492) and the 30-day average ($475), which now act as resistance. The next support is $452.8 (Oct 13 low), then $436 (Jul 29 pivot and 200-day average) and $426 (Sep 3 low). A close back above $476 would ease the pressure; below $436 opens $411.5 (Sep 16 low).
read.zh: 此次下跌跌破了此前两个支撑——10月12日低点（$492）和 30 日均线（$475），二者现转为阻力。下一支撑为 $452.8（10月13日低点），其次 $436（7月29日转折点及 200 日均线）和 $426（9月3日低点）。若收盘重回 $476 上方，压力将缓解；跌破 $436 则打开至 $411.5（9月16日低点）的空间。
